title: Hubspot (Revops & Presales)
description:
**Company Description** 
 Mavlers is a global digital marketing and technology partner that supports organizations as a scalable, behind\-the\-scenes growth engine. With over 90,000 projects delivered by a team of 800\+ professionals across more than 52 countries, Mavlers collaborates with leading brands such as Disney, National Geographic, Incubeta, and Ogilvy. The company provides integrated services across CRM, MarTech, SEO, PPC, and Web Development, offering flexible teams that align with client workflows and business objectives. Mavlers focuses on co\-owning outcomes, helping clients expand services, onboard more customers, and achieve sustainable growth without the cost of large in\-house teams. Through thought leadership content, including the Marketing Insider Series and in\-depth blogs, Mavlers shares practical strategies and insights that drive measurable impact.
   

**Role Description** 
 This is a part\-time remote role for a HubSpot (RevOps \& Presales) specialist at Mavlers. The role involves configuring and optimizing HubSpot CRM and associated RevOps processes, including pipeline setup, automation, reporting, and data hygiene to support sales and marketing alignment. The specialist will participate in presales activities such as requirement discovery, solution design, demos, and documentation that clearly communicate how HubSpot can address client needs. Day\-to\-day tasks include collaborating with internal teams and prospective clients, preparing proposals and scopes of work, creating playbooks and process documentation, and supporting onboarding and handover to delivery teams. The individual will also analyze performance metrics, recommend operational improvements, and contribute to best practices for HubSpot usage across client engagements.
   

**Qualifications**
* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills to interpret CRM data, optimize pipelines, and support data\-driven decision\-making.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication skills for stakeholder collaboration, client presentations, and clear documentation.
* Candidates should possess Consulting capabilities to understand business processes, propose HubSpot\-based solutions, and guide RevOps improvements.
* Candidates should possess Customer Service skills to manage client expectations, provide responsive support, and build long\-term relationships.
* Candidates should possess Presales experience, including discovery, solution mapping, demo preparation, and contributing to proposals.
* Hands\-on experience with HubSpot CRM, Marketing, and Sales hubs, including workflows, integrations, and reporting.
* Knowledge of revenue operations best practices across marketing, sales, and customer success functions.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage part\-time schedules, and prioritize multiple client requests.
* Experience in digital marketing, SaaS, or agency environments is preferred; certifications in HubSpot or RevOps are an advantage.

title: Lead Solutions Engineer
description:
**At Cadence, we hire and develop leaders and innovators who want to make an impact on the world of technology.**
 Understand/review Design specification and develop verification strategy/Test plan/coverage plan. Development of constrained random verification environments and verification components. * Good knowledge of at least one of the USB/PCIE/Ethernet/DDR/LPDDR or similar protocols

**We’re doing work that matters. Help us solve what others can’t.**

title: Field Service Engineer
description:
Leica Biosystems’ mission of “Advancing Cancer Diagnostics, Improving Lives” is at the heart of our corporate culture. We’re a global leader in cancer diagnostics with the most comprehensive portfolio from biopsy to diagnosis. Our easy\-to\-use and consistently reliable offerings help improve workflow efficiency and diagnostic confidence. Our associates know that every moment matters when it comes to cancer diagnostics. When you come to work, you’re helping develop solutions that enable accurate diagnoses to turn anxiety into answers. Join our diverse, global team of talented people, and be inspired to grow every day.
   

  

 Leica Biosystems is proud to work alongside a community of six fellow Diagnostics Companies at Danaher. Together, we’re working at the pace of change to improve patient lives with diagnostic tools that address the world’s biggest health challenges.
   

  

 The Field Service Engineer (FSE) will be in charge of delivering excellent customer support \& servicing on leading edge Leica products to our academic research, pharmaceutical, \& clinical diagnostic customers in Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh and Chhattisgarh. The FSE will provide technical support either on site or via phone, email and remote support to end users and channel partners on our digital pathology products and advanced staining products, as well as our core histology range. FSE is responsible for installation, maintenance and repair of the system with full technical background of the system, use of proper tools and understanding of the standard process.
   

  

 This position is part of the Commercial Department of LBS located in Ahmedabad and will be Remote. At Leica Biosystems, our vision is to advance cancer diagnostics and improve lives.
   

  

 You will be a part of the Service Team and report to the Regional Service Manager WEST who is responsible for achieving annual service strategies and goals through management of FSE’s \& Channel Partner Associates in indirect market, develop commercial programs and area service plans in close conjunction with the Service Excellence manager APAC to support and grow Leica Biosystems’ customers in West and AP/TL region. If you thrive in a fast paced, result driven, matrixed organization, and want to work to build a world\-class commercial team, read on.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To**
* Install, maintaining the instruments and Providing Basic Operation Training during Installation to Provide effective product and customer support.
* Responsible for providing outstanding customer service in a prompt and efficient manner for all product lines and product offerings
* Acquire extensive and sound product knowledge in order to provide support to our customers in a timely and effective manner,


**The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include**
* Degree in Bio\-medical engineering, Electronics, or other related specialties and experience in Clinical diagnostic or Histopathology product supports.
* Good command of written and spoken English and a team player with own initiative who focus on problem solving skills
* Ability to comfortably work in an environment of change and continuing organizational evolution by being flexible and adaptable to changing environment and needs


 Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real\-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.
   

  

 For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

title: Account Manager-Vadodara
description:
Work Your Magic with us!
   

  

 Ready to explore, break barriers, and discover more? We know you’ve got big plans – so do we! Our colleagues across the globe love innovating with science and technology to enrich people’s lives with our solutions in Healthcare, Life Science, and Electronics. Together, we dream big and are passionate about caring for our rich mix of people, customers, patients, and planet. That\`s why we are always looking for curious minds that see themselves imagining the unimageable with us.
   

  

**Your Role**
* Own the full sales cycle for assigned Life Science accounts and territory, from prospecting to closing, with tailored account plans to accelerate revenue and deepen partnerships.
* Combine scientific expertise with commercial strategy to identify new business opportunities and articulate product value to key stakeholders.
* Build and nurture leadership\-level relationships with customers and distribution partners to strengthen market presence and trust.
* Collaborate closely with Specialist teams, Marketing, and Customer Experience, to coordinate cross\-functional activities and deliver outstanding customer experience.
* Maintain a robust short\- and long\-term pipeline, leveraging digital tools to improve prospecting, qualification, and sales conversion.
* Monitor competitive dynamics within the territory and translate insights into actionable market and account strategies.
* Provide strategic input to inform market strategy and ensure your contributions are visible to senior leadership.


**Who You Are**
* You hold a degree in Life Sciences, Chemistry, Biotechnology, or a related field, or bring equivalent professional experience in a scientific sales environment.
* You have substantial experience in account management or field sales within the Life Science industry, with a proven track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
* You bring strong knowledge of the Life Science market, including an understanding of customer segments, competitive landscape, and distribution dynamics.
* You are skilled at building and sustaining relationships with a diverse range of stakeholders — from laboratory end\-users to senior decision\-makers — through both in\-person and digital engagement.
* You are proficient in using CRM systems to manage pipeline, track customer interactions, and generate actionable insights that support strategic decision\-making.
* You demonstrate strong analytical and problem\-solving capabilities, with the ability to interpret market data, identify growth opportunities, and develop effective account strategies.
* You communicate with clarity and confidence, adapting your style to different audiences, and you thrive in a collaborative, cross\-functional environment.


 What we offer: We are curious minds that come from a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences. We celebrate all dimensions of diversity and believe that it drives excellence and innovation, strengthening our ability to lead in science and technology. We are committed to creating access and opportunities for all to develop and grow at your own pace. Join us in building a culture of inclusion and belonging those impacts millions and empowers everyone to work their magic and champion human progress!
   

  

 Apply now and become a part of our diverse team!
